bodyReadLimitations.interpretation: The 16 body-read errors occur in the four 390/1440 practice interaction contexts that include a reload. These contexts also retained the initial five complete font resource hashes. No body-read errors occurred in the fresh 901/1440 failing device pairs. The errors are CDP response-body retrieval limits; font runtime failure or a precise caching mechanism is not inferred.

fonts.conclusion: Fresh failing pairs loaded the same primary text faces from byte-identical Google CSS and WOFF resources. The full Manrope fallback stack differs by source’s additional Arial entry. All check/load calls were already true before explicit loading and no recorded emphasis geometry changed across the load pass. The removed 901 glyph drift cannot be attributed to an observed late font load.

glyphDiagnostic.interpretation: This third capture has matching glyph ranges. No evidence identifies what caused the second run’s baseline-only drift, so it remains retained as prior diagnostic history.

established: All three fixed samples in each of12device records are byte-identical; waiting longer is not justified by these samples.

The fresh failing 901/1440 pairs have identical measured native scroll/root/device geometry, primary text descriptors, returned loaded face records and font resource bytes. The Manrope fallback stack includes Arial in source and is recorded separately.

At1440 the third source image is byte-identical to the first passing source image, while the protected image has changed. At1280 the third protected image returns to its first-run identity while source remains unchanged.
The visible difference is a device raster difference, not a recorded section geometry or font identity difference.

independentPixelAnalysis.method: For question-text pixels on an exact flat background, channel coverage a=(B-P)/(B-F), F=(37,53,38), B=(250,249,247), with edge samples restricted to mean coverage between 0.05 and 0.95. Per-pixel spread is max(aR,aG,aB)-min(aR,aG,aB).
independentPixelAnalysis.conclusion: The retained device text shows two distinct raster modes consistent with LCD/subpixel and grayscale antialiasing, and their assignment to source/published reverses across runs and widths. This is evidence about observed pixel mode, not proof of the compositor lifecycle cause. All threshold-exceeding differences at 1440 and 901 fall within device bands.
